summary: News Corp filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 announcing a daily ASX disclosure of its existing $1 billion stock repurchase program. The program authorizes the issuer to buy back Class A and Class B common stock from time to time, with no specific price, premium, or timeline. No board recommendation, advisor, or unusual structural terms are mentioned. The filing is a routine regulatory compliance update for cross-listed shares, not a special situation. Daily ASX reporting is a standard requirement for Australian-listed entities conducting on-market buybacks. There is no catalyst, contest, or material change; this is purely procedural.
